chapter.heading: Praise for the Lord’s MerciesA Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
Bless the
Lord, O my soul;And all that is within me, bless His holy name! [[Matt. 5:6; John 4:14; 7:37; Rev. 21:6; 22:17] b [Matt. 13:44; Rev. 3:18]]

Bless the
Lord, O my soul,And forget not all His benefits:

Who forgives
all your iniquities,Who heals all your diseases, [Matt. 11:28] [Is. 54:8; 61:8; Jer. 32:40 e]

Who redeems
your life from destruction,Who crowns you with lovingkindness and tender mercies, [[John 18:37; Rev. 1:5] g [Jer. 30:9; Ezek. 34:23; Dan. 9:25]]

Who satisfies
your mouth with good things,So that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s. [Is. 60:9] [Is. 52:15; Eph. 2:11, 12 $ i Is. 60:5]

The Lord
executes righteousnessAnd justice for all who are oppressed. [Matt. 5:25; 25:11; John 7:34; 8:21; 2 Cor. 6:2; [Heb. 3:13] l Ps. 32:6; Is. 49:8]

He made
known His ways to Moses,His acts to the children of Israel. [Is. 1:16 n Is. 59:7; Zech. 8:17] [Ps. 130:7; Jer.]

The Lord
is merciful and gracious,Slow to anger, and abounding in mercy. [2 Sam. 7:19]

He will
not always strive with us,Nor will He keep His anger forever. [Ps. 103:11]

He has
not dealt with us according to our sins,Nor punished us according to our iniquities.

As far
as the east is from the west,So far has He removed our transgressions from us. [Is. 35:10 v Ps. 98:8 w 1 Chr. 16:33]

As a
father pities his children,So the Lord pities those who fear Him. [Is. 41:19 y Mic. 7:4 z Jer. 13:11]

For He
knows our frame;He remembers that we are dust.

As for
man, his days are like grass;As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

For the
wind passes over it, and it is gone,And its place remembers it no more.

But the
mercy of the Lord is from everlasting to everlastingOn those who fear Him,And His righteousness to children’s children,

To such
as keep His covenant,And to those who remember His commandments to do them.

The Lord
has established His throne in heaven,And His kingdom rules over all.

Bless the
Lord, you His angels,Who excel in strength, who do His word,Heeding the voice of His word.

Bless the
Lord, all you His hosts,You ministers of His, who do His pleasure.

Bless the
Lord, all His works,In all places of His dominion.Bless the Lord, O my soul!
